ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Credit Submittal')) && (ISBLANK(Mailing_Address_1__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_Address_City__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_Address_State__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_Address_Zip__c) || ISBLANK(Physical_Address_1__c) || ISBLANK(Physical_Address_City__c) || ISBLANK(Physical_Address_State__c) || ISBLANK(Physical_Address_Zip__c)) && ISCHANGED(StageName)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All Mailing Address and Physical Address fields must be completed before updating the Stage to 'Credit Submittal'.
